t: The Center Holds: Building Your Forever Actualizer Machine with LPvg and Local AI
s: This article advocates for a 'centered' approach to digital sovereignty, rejecting cloud extremes for a local-first, AI-augmented 'forever actualizer machine' built on the LPvg stack (Linux, Python, Vim, Git) and fortified by Nix. It presents this as an antidote to digital feudalism and enshittification.
sub: The Paradox of Digital Extremes and LLM 'Lost-in-the-Middle'
LPvg Stack as the Foundation for a Local-First Forever Machine
Countering Enshittification with Digital Sovereignty and Script Kiddie Deluxe Empowerment
The Seven-Screen Centering Metaphor for Digital Workspace Organization
Local AI as a Tool for Personal Sovereignty vs. Cloud Subscriptions
